title: JS mirror duplicates canonical core logic — drift risk
description: The OpenCode JS plugin mirrors DIRECTIVE_SEPARATOR, isDirectiveLifecycleDedupEnabled(), splitDirectiveBrief(), and core decideOpenCodeDirectiveLifecycle() logic from the canonical TypeScript core. Any change to separator, schema version, or decision logic must be made in two places.
scopeProof: mk-skill-advisor.js:66-68 (DIRECTIVE_SEPARATOR), :246-249 (isDirectiveLifecycleDedupEnabled), :251-257 (splitDirectiveBrief), :260-292 (decideOpenCodeDirectiveLifecycle) all duplicate logic from directive-lifecycle.ts:38,44-48,72-179
affectedSurfaceHints: Any change to directive-lifecycle.ts separator or decision logic requires matching change in mk-skill-advisor.js

title: Epoch-advancement bridge circuit not verified end-to-end
description: notifyDirectiveLifecycleBoundary() spawns a compiled JS dist via synchronous spawnSync. If the dist is missing or broken, it silently returns false. All 8 lifecycle adapters call this without checking the return value. The entire REQ-P1-001 epoch-advancement contract could be non-functional without visible error.
scopeProof: directive-lifecycle-boundary.ts:42-58 shows spawnSync with no return-value enforcement by callers; session-prime.ts:316-319 calls notifyDirectiveLifecycleBoundary without capturing return value
affectedSurfaceHints: All 8 lifecycle adapters depend on this bridge for epoch advancement

title: Synchronous spawnSync with 500ms timeout in hook context
description: Boundary bridge uses spawnSync with 500ms timeout. In hook context where total budget is ~2500ms, a blocking 500ms synchronous subprocess is a latent latency concern. Uses SIGKILL which prevents graceful cleanup.
affectedSurfaceHints: All lifecycle hooks that call notifyDirectiveLifecycleBoundary add 500ms synchronous blocking
